global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with tender noodles, topped with crisp greens, bean sprouts, and sesame seeds. A white ceramic bowl holds the steaming dish, set on a wooden table under warm, natural light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows warm brown tones, smooth grain patterns, and subtle natural texture under soft lighting.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with blue rim, smooth glazed surface, slightly chipped edge, circular shape.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu ramen broth is rich, golden-brown, with visible noodles and toppings floating on its glossy, textured surface.
regions.spoon: White ceramic spoon holds red sauce, bean sprouts, and green onions, with smooth surface and small hole at handle end.
